column1: # Managed type inventory for the server binary, from ILSpy.
# NESTED types are rows too, under their parent's dotted path
# (terraria.player.settings), because the ILSpy inventory lists them
# and because a nested type owns its own members.
# `fields` is the number of rows in the sibling fields sheet whose
# `type` is this id, so the two agree by construction (dec018).
# Type ids are dotted namespace paths, so the compound-key exception is declared.
# A TYPE and a FIELD of its parent can fold to the same id, because ids
# are lowercase (D7) while C# is case-sensitive: the field
# `Player.settings` and the nested type `Player.Settings`. Check 13 is
# exempted because both rows are correct (dec019).
# dropped_reason: compiler-generated types have no emitted .cs file (dec010); resource shims were also absent from the inventory comparison
